_README.purpose: Legacy mock responses for AIWrapper direct calls
_README.status: DEPRECATED - Use modular AI services instead
_README.migration: New AI tasks should use service pattern (GardenAnalysisService, PlantCareService, etc.)
details: This file supports legacy job types that still use AIWrapper.makeRequest()
New services (garden_analysis, plant_update_suggestion, weather_based_action, care_recommendation, pest_diagnosis) use programmatic mock generation
Garden_analysis mock was removed as it's now handled by GardenAnalysisService
Future: Consider removing this file entirely once all tasks are migrated to modular services

plant_update_suggestion.action: Water your {plantName} thoroughly and check soil moisture
plant_update_suggestion.reason: Based on typical care patterns, the plant appears to need watering. The soil should be moist but not waterlogged.

tips: Check if top inch of soil is dry before watering

weather_based_action.action: Bring sensitive plants indoors or provide frost protection
weather_based_action.reason: Forecasted temperatures are expected to drop below freezing, which could damage tender plants.

care_recommendation.action: Apply balanced fertilizer to your {plantType} during the growing season
care_recommendation.reason: {plantType} in the {growthStage} stage benefit from regular feeding to support healthy development.

pest_diagnosis.action: Inspect leaves closely for aphids and treat with insecticidal soap if confirmed
pest_diagnosis.reason: The symptoms described ({symptoms}) are consistent with aphid infestation.

additionalInfo.treatment: Spray insecticidal soap on affected areas

general.action: Here's guidance on your gardening question
general.reason: This is a mock response to help you develop without API keys. In production, this would contain detailed, context-aware gardening advice.

additionalInfo.message: Set MOCK_AI=true in .env to use mock responses

_metadata.description: Mock AI responses for development without API keys
notes: Confidence values can have slight randomization applied (+/- 0.05)
To add a new response type, simply add a new key matching the AIRequestType
